experiment: # Maps each Paper D experiment to the data under experiments/tfa-vs-judge/runs/ that holds it.
# TAB-separated: group, glob relative to runs/, one-line note.
# archive_runs.sh reads this to build the by-experiment/ symlink index on /dfs. The index is a VIEW
# over a byte-exact mirror -- nothing is moved or renamed, because all 127 analysis producers
# hardcode paths like runs/r4/scores/... and would break the moment the tree was reorganised.
# OVERLAP IS DELIBERATE. runs/r2, r3, r4, r5 and r8 are single judging rounds re-read by several
# experiments, and bon/ is one flat pool directory serving about eight. A file may therefore appear
# under more than one group. Sizes per group consequently do not sum to the 1.4 GB total.
# Membership comes from what each producer actually opens, not from directory names.
# Validate with: python scripts/check_runs_map.py   (fails on a stale glob or an unindexed file)
